# Ahmed Ziwar - AI & Digital Transformation Consultant | Kuwait & GCC

> Ahmed Ziwar (أحمد زيور) is a Kuwait-based AI and digital transformation consultant, in Kuwait since 2009, with more than 15 years across IT and network administration, IT consulting, digital media and marketing (including Ooredoo Kuwait) and, since 2022, digital solutions and AI. Over the past 12 months he has delivered AI solutions for large enterprises and public-sector organisations: AI avatar and assistant systems, document-intelligence and legal-content portals, AI model gateways and process automation agents. He works with mid-sized companies in Kuwait and the GCC with mature management that value quality over price. Arabic and English.

## Services

- AI readiness & strategy: Where AI fits the business and what to do first. Use-case workshops, data and systems readiness review, prioritised plan, build/buy/partner recommendations.
- AI solution build & delivery: AI assistants and avatar systems, document intelligence and content portals, process automation agents, integrated with existing systems, in Arabic and English.
- AI governance & model gateways: A controlled layer between applications and AI models, with a choice of commercial and open models, access control, usage visibility and cost control.

## Proof: his own AI operations stack

He built and runs his own AI operations stack: a persistent AI memory and knowledge system, self-hosted secrets management, a self-hosted web-intelligence (crawling) service, and multi-model orchestration (Claude, Codex/GPT, open models) with cost control.
